# PASS 3 — everything you CANNOT walk on, plus flat ground cover. Substitute
# {{N}} and {{ITEMS}}, then cut with:
#   python3 .github/art/room.py props games/<id> <room> name1 name2 ...
#
# TWO TO FOUR ITEMS PER SHEET. A request for five portrait busts side by side
# came back as a single close-up of one of them.
#
# Flat ground cover (flowers, tufts, a rug) goes on its own sheet — see the
# variant at the bottom — because it is drawn from directly above, not upright.

A SHEET OF {{N}} PROPS, drawn side by side in ONE image so they share a palette,
a light and a scale. The background of the whole image must be FLAT PURE WHITE
(#FFFFFF), completely uniform, with a crisp hard edge against each prop, a wide
band of flat white between them so they never touch, and a generous white margin
all round.

All props drawn from the SAME gently-angled top-down RPG view the game's rooms
use, standing upright, each sitting on the same invisible ground line at the
bottom, seen whole from base to top, casting no shadow.

LEFT TO RIGHT: {{ITEMS}}

Rich saturated pixel-art rendering with confident dark outlines, matching this
game's room art. No ground, no grass, no scene, no room, no people, no text —
only the props on flat white.

# ---- variant: FLAT ground cover ------------------------------------------
# ...These are FLAT patches seen from directly above, lying on the ground like a
# rug — NOT standing up, NO stems seen from the side, NO height, NO shadow. Each
# patch roughly oval and about twice as wide as it is tall.
